cover.kicker: 封面故事 · 社区热议
cover.title:
曝光 49 万的 REA
真实讨论只有约 9 万
cover.dek: morluto/rea 总星 40.6 万,今天还在榜首。可它的自媒体曝光里清单和营销帖不少,真正在聊用法的人少得多,值得拆开看看。
cover.title_en:
REA draws 491K views,
but real discussion is about 90K
cover.dek_en: morluto/rea sits at 406,246 stars and still leads the board. Much of its exposure comes from list posts and promo copy, and far fewer people are talking about actually using it.

stickers.title: 新热点
stickers.text: impeccable 日增 +2,787,近 7 天日均 1,295,28 日均值 742,还在加速。
stickers.text_en: impeccable gained 2,787 stars today. Its 7-day average is 1,295 against 742 over 28 days, and it is still accelerating.

stickers.title: 论文角
stickers.text: Memory Tax 发现许多专用记忆系统在不少情况下不如朴素 RAG,净价值为负。
stickers.text_en: Memory Tax finds that many dedicated memory systems often lose to plain RAG, with negative net value.

stickers.title: 自发传播
stickers.text: Google 的 elephant-goldfish-model 日增 +1,313,几乎全靠自然传播和一条中文解读。
stickers.text_en: Google's elephant-goldfish-model added 1,313 stars, almost all from organic sharing and one Chinese-language write-up.
